request: Pull the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog and enrich with days-since-added, days-to-due (SLA), and cwe_first columns for federal-agency vulnerability management. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 13 - CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities' on Tableau Server.

sources.name: CISA KEV Catalog
sources.description: CISA-maintained catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities — the authoritative watchlist that federal agencies must remediate under BOD 22-01. Single JSON envelope {title, catalogVersion, dateReleased, count, vulnerabilities:[{cveID, vendorProject, product, vulnerabilityName, dateAdded, shortDescription, requiredAction, dueDate, knownRansomwareCampaignUse, notes, cwes:[]}]}. Public, no auth, refreshes when CISA adds new items. Row per CVE (~1600+ entries).

args.name: KEV Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level temporal features parsed from dateAdded (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Row-level CISA KEV detail.
args.stats_description: Long-form KEV catalog statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over vendorProject and knownRansomwareCampaignUse). Includes daily_count, 30-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies vs baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True). Use to spot vendor-level exploitation spikes and ransomware-linked catalog activity.

outputs.name: CISA KEV Detail
outputs.description: Row-level CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. One row per CVE with cveID, vendorProject, product, vulnerabilityName, dateAdded, shortDescription, requiredAction, dueDate, knownRansomwareCampaignUse (Known/Unknown/etc.), notes URL, cwe_first (comma-joined CWEs), days_since_added, days_to_due (SLA countdown). Plus calendar features from dateAdded. Source: cisa.gov/sites/default/files/feeds/known_exploited_vulnerabilities.json. Refresh: daily.

outputs.name: CISA KEV Stats
outputs.description: Long-form KEV trend statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over vendorProject and knownRansomwareCampaignUse). Includes 30-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to identify vendors with clusters of newly-cataloged exploited CVEs.
